slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: Bulk purchasing can unlock better supplier pricing, but it ties up cash in stock before it's sold. Short-term finance can fund the purchase, letting you capture the discount while spreading the cost across the period it takes to sell through the stock.

caption:
A supplier discount on a larger order can be genuinely valuable, but only if the cash tied up in extra stock doesn't create pressure elsewhere. Short-term finance lets you capture the saving while spreading the cost across the time it takes to sell through the stock.

The maths only works if the discount outweighs the cost of finance, so it's worth running the numbers before committing to the larger order.
